product.olivetti-prodest-pc1hd.summary: Distinct 640 KB Prodest model with NEC V40, integrated V6355 video and a factory 20 MB hard disk.
product.olivetti-prodest-pc1hd.history: The PC 1 HD was sold as a separate member of the Prodest PC 1 family rather than merely as a user-selected disk option. Period Italian advertising documents the 20 MB configuration; surviving board photographs show BIOS 1.21 and a dedicated internal 40-pin disk connection.
product.olivetti-prodest-pc1hd.warning: INITIAL PARTIAL EMULATION: BIOS 1.21, 640 KB, video, floppy and the factory 20 MB XTA path work; FDISK, FORMAT /S and autonomous hard-disk boot are validated. The controller reuses BluMach's common XTA engine and translates V40 DMAU channel 2 to a generic 8237 channel. The exact 40 MB selector geometry and native V40 peripherals remain unresolved.
product.olivetti-prodest-pc1hd.technical: NEC V40 with 8-bit external bus and BIOS-controlled 4.77/8 MHz operation; the current model uses the dedicated BluMach V40 register device over its V20 instruction core.
640 KB are visible to software. A technical guide documents 768 KB physically populated on the PC1HD board; the additional 128 KB are not mapped as conventional memory.
Integrated Yamaha V6355D with 16 KB physical VRAM mirrored at B0000h, B4000h, B8000h and BC000h. BluMach reproduces the aliases and their BIOS-controlled visibility.

One internal 720 KB floppy and an onboard 8-bit XTA controller at 0320h-0323h, IRQ 5, without an option ROM. The initial profile uses the BIOS 1.21 table geometry 667 cylinders, 2 heads and 32 sectors (20.84 MiB).
Dedicated 16 KB system BIOS 1.21, SHA-256 A2C03DC2E8752EA1632B910B4CE46AF7AB5FC6D4B352D8E21703B2ABB5791F96. ROM bytes are not distributed with BluMach.

A traced UCRT64 build passes Resident Diagnostics 1.21 for CPU, ROM, DMA, interrupts, timer and 640 KB RAM. With Spanish MS-DOS 3.20, FDISK creates the partition, FORMAT /S completes and the machine boots autonomously from the 20 MB disk. BIOS normal/4.77 MHz selection works and survives Ctrl+Alt+Del.

The XTA command engine is shared and the V40 DMAU path is an explicit translation layer, not a native integrated DMA implementation. Cold reset, PC1HD turbo-state preservation, sustained disk I/O, broader software and the documented 40 MB alternative still require validation.
Owner observations, board photographs and modern hardware tests for PC 1 and PC 1 HD.
Technical guide to a modern CompactFlash modification; useful for board evidence, but not the factory controller design.
PC 1 HD with 640 KB, one 720 KB drive and the 20 MB factory disk
The 20 MB profile boots from hard disk. The documented 40 MB alternative remains unavailable until its selector and geometry are established.
